text: {"question":"What specific calculation in the paper demonstrates that the influence of a central mass on the CMB angular scale is a positive correction that is too small to resolve the Hubble tension?","reference_answer":"The authors enforce the areal distance result (Eq. 56) into the position of the first acoustic peak (Eq. 34), yielding an expression for ℓ₁ that includes a term proportional to the Hawking–Hayward parameter μ. This calculation shows that the central mass induces a positive, but extremely small, increase in the distance profile, confirming that the effect is negligible compared to the ∼8 % Hubble tension."}
